Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.conceptmap

package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.conceptmap
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    au.csiro.pathling.terminology
     
  • Class
    Description
    ConceptMapContent
    The mappings of one concept map at one resolution: the canonical URL, the version resolved where known, and the deduplicated rows in first-seen order.
    ConceptMapContentException
    Thrown when a concept map resolves but its content cannot be represented as the rows of a concept map relation, or the chosen map could not be read from its source.
    ConceptMapFault
    The reasons that the content of an R4 ConceptMap cannot be represented as the rows of a concept map relation.
    ConceptMapLimitExceededException
    Thrown when a concept map has more mappings than the largest number the caller will accept.
    ConceptMapLookupException
    Thrown in SERVER mode when the ConceptMap search itself fails, with a server error other than 501 or because the server cannot be reached, so that whether the URL names a concept map at all is unknown.
    ConceptMapping
    One row of a concept map relation: a source code with its system, version and display, and a target code with its system, version, display and relationship, or a null target where the map states that the source code has no mapping.
    ConceptMapReader
    Reads a concept map from a FHIR terminology server in three steps: a summary search of ConceptMap resources by canonical URL (and version, where pinned), following next links and keeping the entries whose url equals the request exactly; a choice among the entries, taking the one entry a pinned reference matches and the latest of several an unpinned reference matches; and one read of the chosen resource, converted with ConceptMapContent.fromResource(org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.ConceptMap, int).
    ConceptMapRelationship
    The R5 ConceptMapRelationship codes that a concept map relation carries, and the conversion of an R4 equivalence to one of them.
    ConceptMapVersionException
    Thrown when the version of a concept map to use cannot be determined: an unpinned reference matches several versions with no determinable latest, or a pinned reference matches several resources.
